mapper.select: select id, name, detect_phones, create_time, update_time from product_word_library where owner_id = #{ownerId} and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') order by id desc
select * from product_word_library where id = #{id} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: insert into product_word_library (owner_id, name, title_words, image_words, detect_phones, create_by, create_time) values (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{titleWords}, #{imageWords}, #{detectPhones}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from product_word_library where id = #{id} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
